topic: Break of Structure (BOS) and Change of Character (CHOCH)

break_of_structure.definition: A price move that breaks through a significant swing high or swing low in the direction of the prevailing trend, confirming trend continuation.
break_of_structure.key_distinction: BOS occurs IN the direction of the existing trend; it is a trend-continuation event, not a reversal signal.
valid_break_criteria: Candle must close beyond the swing point (not just wick)
The swing point being broken must be a confirmed swing (prior confirmed swing high or low)
Break should ideally occur with above-average volume

change_of_character.definition: The FIRST break of structure that occurs AGAINST the prevailing trend direction. Signals a potential shift in market character from trend to reversal.
change_of_character.key_distinction: CHOCH is the first structural break against the trend; it is an early reversal warning, not a confirmed reversal. Requires additional confirmation.
valid_choch_criteria: Must be the first structure break in the opposing direction after a trend run
Price should have made at least one fresh swing extreme before the CHOCH forms
Higher probability when CHOCH forms at a significant HTF level (order block, FVG, liquidity pool)

bullish_bos.definition: Price closes above a Lower High (LH) in an established downtrend, indicating buyers are overcoming seller control at a structural level.
bullish_bos.structure_before: sequence of Lower Highs (LH) and Lower Lows (LL)
bullish_bos.trigger: close above the most recent confirmed Lower High
bullish_bos.significance: Breaks the pattern of lower highs; suggests demand is now strong enough to push through supply at a prior swing high
confirmation_factors: Close is above the LH on the timeframe being analyzed (not just a wick)
Break holds (price does not immediately fall back below the LH)
Higher timeframe structure is also turning bullish
bullish_bos.post_bos_expectation: Pullback to the broken LH (now potential support); if holds, marks the first Higher Low (HL) — uptrend structure begins
bullish_bos.invalidation: Price falls back below the origin of the BOS candle or the prior LL

bearish_bos.definition: Price closes below a Higher Low (HL) in an established uptrend, indicating sellers are overcoming buyer control at a structural level.
bearish_bos.structure_before: sequence of Higher Highs (HH) and Higher Lows (HL)
bearish_bos.trigger: close below the most recent confirmed Higher Low
bearish_bos.significance: Breaks the pattern of higher lows; suggests supply is now strong enough to push through demand at a prior swing low
confirmation_factors: Close is below the HL on the timeframe being analyzed (not just a wick)
Break holds (price does not immediately recover above the HL)
Higher timeframe structure is also turning bearish
bearish_bos.post_bos_expectation: Rally to the broken HL (now potential resistance); if rejected, marks the first Lower High (LH) — downtrend structure begins
bearish_bos.invalidation: Price recovers above the origin of the BOS candle or the prior HH

choch_bullish.definition: First break above a Lower High after a series of LH + LL formations; marks the first counter-trend structural move.
sequence: Price rallies and closes ABOVE LH2
This close above LH2 is the CHOCH
choch_bullish.significance_for_trend_shift: CHOCH signals the downtrend may be ending; smart money may be accumulating; structural bias shifts from bearish to neutral/cautiously bullish
required_follow_through: Pullback after CHOCH that holds above prior LL (forms first HL)
Subsequent rally that forms a Higher High above CHOCH level
Volume confirmation on the new HH
choch_bullish.risk: False CHOCH — price breaks above LH temporarily then resumes downtrend (lower low still forms); treat CHOCH as alert, not confirmed reversal

choch_bearish.definition: First break below a Higher Low after a series of HH + HL formations; marks the first counter-trend structural move.
sequence: Price declines and closes BELOW HL2
This close below HL2 is the CHOCH
choch_bearish.significance_for_trend_shift: CHOCH signals the uptrend may be ending; smart money may be distributing; structural bias shifts from bullish to neutral/cautiously bearish
required_follow_through: Rally after CHOCH that holds below prior HH (forms first LH)
Subsequent decline that forms a Lower Low below CHOCH level
Volume confirmation on the new LL
choch_bearish.risk: False CHOCH — price breaks below HL temporarily then resumes uptrend (higher high still forms); treat CHOCH as alert, not confirmed reversal

significance_for_trend_shift.bos_trend_continuation: BOS in trend direction confirms trend is healthy and likely to continue; reinforces existing bias
significance_for_trend_shift.choch_trend_reversal_warning: CHOCH is the earliest structural warning of a trend shift; probability increases when CHOCH forms at HTF levels
full_reversal_confirmation_sequence: 1. CHOCH against trend (first structural break opposite to trend)
2. Pullback that holds (does not return to prior extreme)
3. Second structural break confirming new trend direction (first BOS in new trend direction)
significance_for_trend_shift.timeframe_hierarchy: Always check CHOCH/BOS on at least one higher timeframe; a CHOCH on LTF within an HTF BOS continuation zone is a pullback entry, not a reversal

bos.trade_action: enter or add in trend direction

choch.trade_action: reduce position in trend direction; watch for reversal setup but wait for confirmation
choch.confidence: low alone; high when combined with HTF level + volume + follow-through

agent_rules.condition: price closes above a confirmed Lower High in a downtrend
agent_rules.action: mark bullish BOS; upgrade bias to NEUTRAL; wait for pullback test of broken LH to confirm as support before entering long

agent_rules.condition: price closes below a confirmed Higher Low in an uptrend
agent_rules.action: mark bearish BOS; downgrade bias to NEUTRAL; wait for rally test of broken HL to confirm as resistance before entering short

agent_rules.condition: first structural break against prevailing trend (CHOCH) identified
agent_rules.action: flag CHOCH; do not immediately reverse position; require follow-through confirmation (HL hold in bullish CHOCH, LH hold in bearish CHOCH) before acting
confirm trend continuation; look for pullback entries in trend direction; do not fade the BOS

agent_rules.condition: BOS on lower timeframe conflicts with higher timeframe structure
agent_rules.action: defer to higher timeframe structure; treat LTF BOS as a counter-trend move within HTF trend; no trade or fade setup only
treat BOS as low-confidence; reduce position size; require additional confirmation before full entry

agent_rules.condition: CHOCH followed by first HL (bullish) or first LH (bearish)
agent_rules.action: upgrade reversal confidence to MODERATE; look for entry on the first pullback in new trend direction

agent_rules.condition: two consecutive BOS events in new trend direction after CHOCH
agent_rules.action: classify trend as officially reversed; apply full trend-following rules in new trend direction
